are_you_ok.title: Ground stop in place for Denver International Airport as storms move in
are_you_ok.summary: A ground stop has been issued for Denver International Airport, the region's main airport about 45 miles southeast of Boulder, CO, due to thunderstorms moving into the area.
questions: Have the storms around Denver International Airport disrupted any of your travel plans?
How has the stormy weather been where you are?

you_should_know.title: Multiple Colorado reservoirs announce boat ramp closures due to dropping water levels, another fish salvage announced
you_should_know.description: Monsoon rains have not been enough to end Colorado's drought, and several more areas have announced boat ramp closures as water levels in our reservoirs continue to drop.

you_should_know.title: Colorado River plan spares upper basin states from mandatory cuts, for now
you_should_know.description: The U.S. Department of the Interior has issued its plan for how to manage water on the Colorado River.

you_should_know.title: Advocates say Denver’s cooling centers leave gaps for people living outside during extreme heat
you_should_know.description: Advocates want dedicated emergency shelter and a pause on encampment sweeps.

you_should_know.title: Aurora looks at successes and struggles of water conservation efforts as drought continues
you_should_know.description: On Saturday morning, lawmakers and residents gathered in Aurora for an update on the city's water usage amid the drought.
